claims.text: Following the major update Announcing The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered on 2026-08-25, sentiment timeseries data showed 4875 total reviews in the window with a share of 93.93 percent positive.
The estimated patch effect on positive share at horizon 14 was 1.16 percentage points.
Reviewers expressed frustration over pricing adjustments after announcement of free expansions.
Platform policy negative mentions changed by 6.79 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline.
Players criticized corporate policies affecting specific regions and operating system support.

report.summary: Following the major update Announcing The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered on 2026-08-25, sentiment timeseries data showed 4875 total reviews in the window with a share of 93.93 percent positive. The estimated patch effect on positive share at horizon 14 was 1.16 percentage points. Reviewers expressed frustration over pricing adjustments after announcement of free expansions. Platform policy negative mentions changed by 6.79 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline. Players criticized corporate policies affecting specific regions and operating system support. The patch, a price change or sale, and off-topic reviews or a review bomb are inconclusive, while a change in who reviewed and noise or seasonality are rejected.
